steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Augustus established the principate — supreme power while maintaining the appearance of the Republic | Key Fact: The emperor's power rested on control of the army, the treasury and religious office of pontifex maximus | Key Fact: Imperial propaganda used coins, statues, architecture and literature to project the emperor's image | Key Fact: Augustus's Res Gestae was a masterful exercise in self-promotion and political messaging
